title: In Nebraska, Americans begin to lose Medicaid under Trump's work rules
summary: Nebraska's Medicaid director, in an exclusive interview with nonprofit news organization Tradeoffs, said roughly 200 people will lose health coverage on Aug. 1.
contentText:
Nebraska's Medicaid director, in an exclusive interview with nonprofit news organization Tradeoffs , said roughly 200 people will lose health coverage on Aug. 1.
